time_policy.occurrence_time: When the clinical fact/action actually occurred or specimen was obtained.
time_policy.available_at: Earliest time or interval when the treating team could use that information, as supported by the paper.
time_policy.unknown_exact_time: Represented as an interval plus partial-order constraints; no midpoint is promoted to fact.
time_policy.same_specimen_late_result: Occurrence remains the collection/biopsy day while available_at records the later result interval.
time_policy.no_future_leakage: A cut may consume an event only when its available_at is resolved before that cut or the cut is explicitly defined as after that event. Narrative-later facts cannot be backfilled into earlier cuts.
time_policy.reported_length_of_stay: The paper reports a 15-day hospitalization. This is stored as duration=15 days, not promoted to an exact zero-based hospital_day=15 timestamp.

layer_policy.observation: Direct symptoms, measurements, imaging, morphology, or assay reports. Observed concepts do not encode a disease label.
layer_policy.action: Orders, specimens, procedures, medications, monitoring, or discharge planning.
layer_policy.clinical_hypothesis: What the treating team considered, upgraded, or downgraded. It is never treated as ground truth observation.
layer_policy.report_conclusion: Diagnostic language in a report when the source does not expose a diagnosis-neutral raw feature; excluded from rankable observations.
layer_policy.future_plan: Not-yet-realized post-discharge plan. Never treated as completed action or outcome.
